$comment: What the scripts, skills and agent need to know about MindfulnessReminder. Since 2026-11-10 the project is the root of its own repository and holds the kit's files itself (ADR 0038): scripts/, .claude/skills/, .claude/agents/ and .claude/rules/ are edited here; the kit's decisions are in docs/decisions/kit/ and its guide is GHID.md. The layout is the kit's default, src/ and tests/ (ADR 0002). There is no test data and no validation case (ADR 0005): the manifest lists nothing, testFilter is empty, and MINDFULNESS_TESTDATA_LARGE is the override process-config.ps1 requires a name for, which nobody sets. The release publishes the application framework-dependent, as the README's deployment note does, so no runtime is declared (ADR 0002; the kit's ADR 0034 does not apply). processTests are the tests of scripts/, in tests/MindfulnessReminder.ProcessTests/, which take minutes: the gate runs them when one of their paths differs from main, in CI and at a release. See scripts/process-config.ps1 for every key.
